description: One partner vault read from the chain alone, gage's index not asked, so it answers while the index does not: which generation, its book, whether a settlement is due, its manager's settings and what waits (the figures Manage shows), and with a wallet its shares, what they are worth, what the vault can pay it now and the call that withdraws that. Signs nothing.

wallet.description: A holder: adds its shares, what they are worth, what the vault can pay it now, and the call that withdraws that
